principles: Raw VitalDB measurements are immutable and must remain available internally for provenance and technical review.
Physiologically impossible or semantically unresolved numeric values must not be presented as valid clinical measurements.
Invalid values are not silently corrected, clipped, rescaled, interpolated, or replaced.
The Explorer should distinguish source availability from clinical display validity.
A technically valid waveform may still be blocked from physiological amplitude interpretation.
Downstream analysis must use analysis_valid rather than mere source availability.

future_explorer_behavior.display_valid_true: Display the source measurement with appropriate metadata.
future_explorer_behavior.display_valid_false: Do not show the impossible raw number as a valid clinical measurement. Display 'Unavailable / invalid source value' or an equivalent explicit status.
future_explorer_behavior.analysis_valid_true: Measurement may enter downstream analysis subject to analysis-specific QC.
future_explorer_behavior.analysis_valid_false: Block the measurement from automatic physiological calculations.
future_explorer_behavior.raw_value_policy: Retain original source values internally and in provenance/audit views. Never silently modify them.

arterial_waveform_policy.negative_baseline: May be shown as a raw technical waveform with a warning, but must not be interpreted as calibrated arterial pressure until scale semantics are established.
